## APMG Enquiry Notification

POST /webhook/enquiry-notify

Body: { notifyTo, enquiry: { id, service, name, email, phone, message,
business, category, campaign, source } }

`notifyTo` may be a comma-separated list - the Gmail node splits it and puts
every recipient on ONE To: header, so a list costs one Gmail send, not one
per address. No re-paste needed when the operator adds addresses.

NOTE: this webhook has NO authentication. The app already sends the
x-apmg-secret header; adding Header Auth here would close it.
